summary.intent: Refactor the api-client package from a module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios, so multiple CipherBoxClient instances can use different tokens simultaneously without cross-contamination.
summary.outcome: Full singleton elimination across the monorepo: CipherBoxClient creates/accepts its own axios instance, the web app's api-config.ts creates a shared instance passed to both the singleton path and CipherBoxClient, and all test infrastructure workarounds (switchTo, setApiClientConfig calls) were removed.

repo: The web app uses two call paths to the API: direct imports from @cipherbox/api-client (auth, vault, shares, invites, device approval, health) and CipherBoxClient (folder/file/bin ops) — Phase 19.1 only partially rewired the web app.
The singleton in api-client/instance.ts had a getCachedInstance function that duplicated 401 refresh interceptor logic — now consolidated into createAxiosInstance.
sdk-core does not directly depend on axios; AxiosInstance type must be imported from @cipherbox/api-client or via dynamic import('axios').
pnpm test runs all package test suites in parallel, which causes 429 rate-limit errors from the live API when multiple suites hit it simultaneously — tests pass in isolation.
The MultiAccountFixture's switchTo() hack existed solely to work around the singleton — e2e tests in share-operations and invite-link called it before every cross-account operation.

code.finding: customInstance now accepts optional _axiosInstance in its options parameter, bypassing the singleton when provided. createAxiosInstance centralizes all interceptor setup including 401 refresh.
SdkContext gained optional axiosInstance field; threaded through to all IPNS function calls across ipns, folder, file, and bin modules.
createAndPublishIpnsRecord, batchPublishIpnsRecords, and resolveIpnsRecord each accept optional ctx to forward the axios instance into the customInstance options.
Refactored to call createAxiosInstance() from api-client, then pass the pre-built instance to setApiClientConfig — making the singleton and CipherBoxClient share one instance.
initSdkClient now imports sharedAxiosInstance and passes it as axiosInstance in CipherBoxClientConfig, so the SDK client reuses the web app's instance.
Constructor uses config.axiosInstance if provided, otherwise falls back to createAxiosInstance() — allows external instance injection without breaking SDK standalone usage.
Mock assertions for ipnsControllerPublishRecord needed updating after ctx parameter was added — toHaveBeenCalledWith needed second argument (undefined options).
Had a leftover setApiClientConfig call that was removed since the client now creates its own instance with headers from CipherBoxClientConfig.defaultHeaders.

workflow: When threading a new parameter through multiple layers, grep for all callers of the affected functions before declaring done — bin/index.ts IPNS calls were initially missed.
Rate-limit 429 errors in test output during pnpm test are a false signal when tests pass in isolation — add a brief cooldown or run packages sequentially to confirm.
The resolve-pr-comments workflow (GraphQL for fetching/resolving threads, REST for replies) works well; curl -fsS vs -s is a meaningful security distinction for health check loops.

friction: AxiosInstance type import: sdk package can't import directly from 'axios' (not a direct dep) — had to use import type from api-client re-export instead.
pnpm test parallelism causes 429 from live API, making it hard to confirm a clean test run without running packages serially or adding artificial cooldowns.
Phase 19.1 ROADMAP.md shows all plans 'complete' with unchecked checkboxes — misleading state that caused confusion about whether web app rewiring was actually done.
The bin/index.ts IPNS callers were missed in the first pass of ctx threading, requiring a second typecheck cycle to catch.
open_items: The 13 web app files that still import directly from @cipherbox/api-client (auth, vault, shares, invites, device approval, health, IPFS, IPNS) now share the singleton instance with CipherBoxClient, but are not yet routed through CipherBoxClient itself — full migration deferred.
ROADMAP.md Phase 19.1 checkbox state is inconsistent (plans marked complete but boxes unchecked) — should be reconciled.
pnpm test parallel 429 issue: consider adding rate-limit bypass headers to all test clients or serializing API-hitting test suites to avoid flaky CI.
